unified_theorem_statement:
UNIFIED THEOREM (Cross-Session Family, S85-W2-2):

  Let (A, H, D) be a spectral triple satisfying the 5-axiom subset
  {dimension, regularity, finiteness, reality, first-order} of CCM-2007,
  with finite fiber sector carried by an algebra/group structure G
  (compact simply-laced Lie, direct-sum finite-dim, or product with
  spacetime).  Let:

    k      = cohomology layer of observation (HP^k or HP^even),
    R      = admissible regulator class (single-regulator, multi-regulator
             family, or full taxonomy),
    r_crit = rank or dim-summability threshold on G.

  Then HP^k-structural-triviality of the G-fiber sector (manifested as
  HC^k-primary vanishing, HP^k completeness taxonomy, or HP^k multi-layer
  stratification) forces every R-regulated observable at rank/dim r(G) >= r_crit
  to inherit the corresponding structural constraint.

  Instantiations form a family keyed by (k, R, G, r_crit).

instantiations.title: Cartan Level-2 Exclusion
instantiations.structural_content: HC^2_primary(C) = 0 for C = abelian Cartan subfactor
instantiations.consequence: drift_u1 ~ noise floor by Weyl-equivalence; non-simply-laced (G_2, F_4) falsified at r=2

instantiations.title: HP^even Completeness (4-bucket taxonomy)
instantiations.structural_content: HP^even classifies 53/53 rows: P=35, CM=7, M=10, GV=1
instantiations.consequence: Every framework observable is assigned one of 4 bucket labels; GV excluded from admissibility per CE6

instantiations.title: Three-Layer Regulator Theorem
instantiations.structural_content: L1 zeta (axiomatic global) / L2 Zubarev (substrate-action at tau_fold) / L3 per-Q span (residual)
instantiations.consequence: Regulator uniqueness in 2/3 layers; 3rd layer is residual; CC-5 propagation applies ONLY at L3
instantiations.note: Plan references §VII.M, but actual registry slot is §VII.N (per S84 W2a-11 landing memo collision note; §VII.M occupied by DR3-RESPONSE-PROTOCOL)

predicted_instantiations.title: HP^3 Rank-2 Extension (conjectured)
predicted_instantiations.consequence: Would extend §VII.J's rank-2 protection from HC^2 to HP^3, providing falsification handle for the family at k=3
predicted_instantiations.testing_slot: S84 W2a-12 (LAYER-ORDERING-FALSIFIER) references HP^4 / Spin(8)-SU(3) / T^4 / T^8 tests; HP^3 extension is a natural sibling

predicted_instantiations.title: HP^even 4-bucket taxonomy under q-deformation
predicted_instantiations.G_fiber: A_F^q = U_q(A_F) deformation at generic q
predicted_instantiations.structural_content: 4-bucket partition survives q-deformation; verified for Cartan sub-factor in S83 W2-G20
predicted_instantiations.consequence: Extends §VII.K to quantum substrates; tested explicitly in S85-W2-QUANTUM-DISJOINT-CORRIDOR (W2-6)
